tools.name: ucm_connect
tools.description: Connect to UCM and initialise operational context for the conversation. Call this tool FIRST at the start of every conversation — it loads your personalized account information, workspace IDs, repositories, policies, and connected services. Required for conversation initialisation before using any other UCM tools.

tools.name: ucm_workspace_get_index
tools.description: Discover a dynamic markdown index guide for AI assistants working with a workspace's content.

tools.name: ucm_workspace_get_recents
tools.description: Generate workspace activity tracking showing the 20 most recently modified artifacts within a workspace.

tools.name: ucm_workspace_list_repos
tools.description: List all repositories for a specific workspace with pagination and statistics

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: ucm_artifact_get
tools.description: Retrieve UCM artifact content with metadata. Large files are automatically chunked.

path.description: Full artifact path with optional version (e.g., "1234567890/main/commands/user/CreateUserCommand.ts" or "1234567890/main/commands/user/CreateUserCommand.ts@1.0.0")

tools.name: ucm_artifact_get_chunk
tools.description: Retrieve the next chunk of a large UCM artifact response

sequence.description: The sequence number of the chunk to retrieve

tools.name: ucm_artifact_publish_from_file
tools.description: Create or update UCM artifacts from a file URI. Supports versioning. PREFERRED METHOD: Use this tool for file-based content as it is much faster and more efficient. Pass the local file path as a file:// URI (e.g., "file:///path/to/file.txt").

fileUri.description: File URI pointing to the content file (e.g., "file:///tmp/large-file.txt"). Use local file paths converted to file:// URIs.

version.description: Semantic version (e.g., "1.0.0") - optional, defaults to 1.0.0 for new artifacts

technology.description: Technology stack (e.g., "typescript", "python"). Optional and will attempt to auto-detect

tags.description: Optional array of tags for categorization

tools.name: ucm_artifact_publish
tools.description: Create or update UCM artifacts with content and metadata. Supports versioning and automatic conflict detection. The API automatically detects whether to create or update based on existing artifacts. NOTE: Only use this tool for small data - use ucm_artifact_publish_from_file for files as it is much faster and more efficient.

version.description: Semantic version (e.g., "1.0.0") - optional, defaults to 1.0.0 for new artifacts

technology.description: Technology stack (e.g., "typescript", "python"). Optional - only required for certain categories like "implementations"

tags.description: Optional array of tags for categorization

tools.name: ucm_artifact_list
tools.description: List artifacts with exploratory browsing support. Can list authors, repositories, categories, subcategories, or artifacts depending on path depth.

path.description: Exploratory path: empty string or omit for authors, "{author}" for repositories, "{author}/{repository}" for categories, "{author}/{repository}/{category}" for subcategories, or "{author}/{repository}/{category}/{subcategory}" for artifacts. Eg; undefined/main/commands/user

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: ucm_artifact_delete
tools.description: Delete a UCM artifact by path and version. This action cannot be undone. Only the latest or specified version is deleted.

filename.description: Filename with optional version suffix (e.g., "CreateUserCommand.ts" or "CreateUserCommand.ts@1.0.0")

tools.name: ucm_artifact_get_versions
tools.description: Get all available versions of a specific UCM artifact

tools.name: ucm_artifact_search
tools.description: Search your workspaces by text across multiple metadata fields. Searches namespace, filename, description, and tags fields.

searchText.description: Text to search across namespace, repository, category, subcategory, filename, description, and tags (case-insensitive)

workspace.description: Optional workspace filter. Leave empty to search your workspaces.

tags.description: Optional tags filter - comma-separated list of tags to search for

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default: 20, max: 100)

tools.name: ucm_artifact_edit_metadata
tools.description: Edit artifact metadata and move artifacts. Supports updating description, namespace, filename, MIME type, technology, and tags. Move operations affect all versions while metadata-only updates apply to latest version only.

updateDescription.description: New description for the artifact (up to 1000 characters)

updateNamespace.description: New namespace path to move artifact to (e.g., "utaba/main/services/user")

updateMimeType.description: New MIME type for the artifact (e.g., "application/typescript")

tools.name: ucm_artifact_move
tools.description: Move an artifact from one namespace location to another. All versions are moved. Requires read access on source and write access on destination.

tools.name: ucm_repository_create
tools.description: Create a new repository for a specific workspace. Repository names must be unique within the workspace and follow UCM naming conventions. (3-200 characters, start with letter, alphanumeric and hyphens only, no consecutive hyphens).

repositoryName.description: Unique repository name (3-200 characters, start with letter, alphanumeric and hyphens only)

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the repository (optional)

tools.name: ucm_repository_get
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific repository, including metadata, statistics, and available categories. Returns repository details along with its content structure.

tools.name: ucm_repository_update
tools.description: Update repository metadata including display name and description.

repository.description: Repository to update (e.g., "main", "project-alpha") however the name will not change. Only the displayname can be updated after creation.

displayName.description: New human-readable display name for the repository (optional)

tools.name: ucm_connection_list
tools.description: List all External connections including SharePoint available to the user. Returns connection details, use this to discover available connections before searching or browsing.

limit.description: Maximum number of connections to return (default: 20, max: 100)

offset.description: Number of connections to skip for pagination (default: 0)

tools.name: ucm_connection_access
tools.description: Access a specific external connection, check auth status, and return available tool schemas. Call without toolNames to get a summary index of all available tools. Pass toolNames to retrieve full parameter schemas.

connectionId.description: Connection ID (SharePoint connection or Remote MCP Server) from ucm_connection_list

toolNames.description: Optional list of tool names to get full parameter schemas for. If omitted, returns a summary index of all available tools. Pass in all tool names that could likely be relevant.

tools.name: ucm_connection_call_tool
tools.description: Call a tool on an external connection.

connectionId.description: Connection ID (SharePoint connection or Remote MCP Server) from ucm_connection_list

toolName.description: Name of the tool to call (see ucm_connection_access for available tools)

args.description: Tool arguments — passed through to the remote tool as-is

tools.name: ucm_connection_signout
tools.description: Sign out from an OAuth-authorized connection. Revokes user-delegated permissions by deleting access tokens. Works for SharePoint OnBehalfOf connections and Remote MCP Servers with user-delegated OAuth.

connectionId.description: Connection ID to revoke authorization for (get from ucm_connection_list_auth or ucm_connection_list)

tools.name: ucm_connection_list_auth
tools.description: List all your active OAuth authorizations across connection types. Shows which services you are currently authorized to access, with expiry info and connection details.

tools.name: ucm_graph_list
tools.description: List all Memory Graphs you have access to (including those not in a Knowledge Set). Returns graph metadata, embedding status, descriptions, and ownership scope (personal or organization).

scope.description: Filter graphs by ownership scope. "organization" returns only org graphs, "personal" returns only your personal graphs, "all" (default) returns both.

tools.name: ucm_graph_create
tools.description: Create a new Memory Graph with a vocabulary template. Defaults to a personal graph. Set scope to 'organization' to create an org-wide graph (requires Owner role). Call ucm_graph_list_templates first to see available templates.

label.description: Display name for the new Memory Graph

templateId.description: Vocabulary template ID to use for the graph. Use ucm_graph_list_templates to see available templates.

description.description: Optional description of the Memory Graph purpose

scope.description: Graph ownership scope. "personal" (default) creates a graph owned by you. "organization" creates an org-wide graph (requires Owner role).

tools.name: ucm_graph_update
tools.description: Update a Memory Graph's metadata — label, description, or usage instructions. Use this to update usage instructions with per-graph behavioural rules. Whole-document replacement for usageInstructions.

memoryGraphId.description: The ID of the Memory Graph to update

label.description: New display name for the Memory Graph

description.description: New description of the Memory Graph purpose

usageInstructions.description: Per-graph behavioural rules and usage instructions. Whole-document replacement.

tools.name: ucm_graph_list_templates
tools.description: List available vocabulary templates for creating Memory Graphs. Each template defines entity types, relationship types, and property definitions for a specific domain. Use the templateId when calling ucm_graph_create.

tools.name: ucm_knowledge_set_list
tools.description: List Knowledge Sets you have access to. Use `ucm_knowledge_set_open` with a Knowledge Set ID to explore its contents.

tools.name: ucm_knowledge_set_open
tools.description: Open a Knowledge Set to see its contents — Memory Graphs, artifact repositories, and artifact namespaces — with guidance on which tools to use for each.

knowledgeSetId.description: The Knowledge Set ID to open

tools.name: ucm_graph_open
tools.description: Open a Memory Graph and get its vocabulary, statistics, query instructions, usage instructions, and policies. Call this FIRST before querying a graph — it returns the schema (entity types, relationship types, property definitions) needed to construct queries.

memoryGraphId.description: The Memory Graph ID to open

tools.name: ucm_graph_find_entities
tools.description: Find entities in a Memory Graph by label, type, or property filters. Supports pagination and detail levels (brief/summary/full).

searchTerm.description: Search term to match against entity labels (partial match)

detailLevel.description: Detail level for returned entities (default: summary)

tools.name: ucm_graph_get_entity
tools.description: Get full details of an entity including all properties, data, and provenance. Use the entityId from find_entities or explore results.

entityId.description: The entity ID or slug to retrieve

tools.name: ucm_graph_get_relationships
tools.description: Get relationships for an entity with optional type filtering and direction control (out, in, or both).

entityId.description: The entity ID to get relationships for

tools.name: ucm_graph_explore
tools.description: Explore the neighbourhood around an entity using BFS traversal (1-3 hops). Returns connected entities grouped by distance, with optional relationship/entity type filters.

tools.name: ucm_graph_find_paths
tools.description: Find paths between two entities in a Memory Graph. Returns all paths up to the specified max depth with optional relationship/entity type filtering.

tools.name: ucm_graph_traverse
tools.description: Execute a structured graph traversal using a JSON spec. Supports start point selection, ordered hop steps with relationship/entity type filters, property filters, repeat loops, and multiple return modes (terminal, all, paths). The most powerful query tool for complex graph navigation.

entityId.description: Start from a specific entity ID or slug

entityType.description: Start from all entities of this type

operator.description: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, isNull, isNotNull

entityTypes.description: Filter by entity types at this step

entityFilter.description: Property filters on entities at this step

repeat.description: Repeat this step up to maxDepth times

returnMode.description: What to return: terminal (only final step entities), all (every visited entity), path (full traversal paths with relationships). Default: terminal

detailLevel.description: Detail level for returned entities (default: summary)

tools.name: ucm_graph_search
tools.description: Semantic search across one or more Memory Graphs using vector similarity. Uses embeddings if available. Returns entities ranked by relevance to the query concept. Provide memoryGraphId for single-graph search, graphIds (array) for multi-graph search, or omit both to search all accessible graphs.

memoryGraphId.description: Single Memory Graph ID to search (use this for single-graph search)

graphIds.description: Multiple Memory Graph IDs to search across (use this for multi-graph search)

query.description: Natural language query to search for (will be embedded and compared against entity embeddings)

tools.name: ucm_graph_create_entities
tools.description: Create one or more entities in a Memory Graph. Each entity requires a type (from vocabulary) and label. Properties are validated against the vocabulary schema. Pass a single item in the array for single operations.

data.description: Optional freeform data attached to the entity

tools.name: ucm_graph_update_entities
tools.description: Update one or more entities in a Memory Graph. Each update specifies an entityId and the fields to change (label, summary, properties, data). Pass a single item in the array for single operations.

tools.name: ucm_graph_delete_entities
tools.description: Delete one or more entities from a Memory Graph. Each deleted entity also has its relationships removed. Pass entity IDs as an array.

entityIds.description: Array of entity IDs to delete

tools.name: ucm_graph_create_relationships
tools.description: Create one or more relationships between entities in a Memory Graph. Each relationship requires a type (from vocabulary), source entity ID, and target entity ID. Pass a single item in the array for single operations.

tools.name: ucm_graph_delete_relationships
tools.description: Delete one or more relationships from a Memory Graph by their IDs. Pass relationship IDs as an array.

relationshipIds.description: Array of relationship IDs to delete

tools.name: ucm_graph_propose_vocabulary
tools.description: Propose new entity or relationship types, or edit existing types (add/remove/update properties) for a Memory Graph vocabulary. Behaviour depends on the governance mode: auto-approved in "open" mode, queued for review in "managed" mode, rejected in "locked" mode.

justification.description: Why this entity type is needed

type.description: Property type: string, number, boolean, date, enum

properties.description: Property schemas for the entity type

justification.description: Why this relationship type is needed

bidirectional.description: Whether the relationship is symmetric (default: false)

type.description: Property type: string, number, boolean, date, enum

properties.description: Property schemas for the relationship type

editEntityTypes.description: Edits to existing entity types — add, remove, or update properties

type.description: Existing entity type name to modify

updateProperties.description: Existing properties to update (matched by name)

type.description: Existing relationship type name to modify

updateProperties.description: Existing properties to update (matched by name)
